minecraft_angry_villager.description: Essentially empty at every angle and tick. The only anomaly is a tiny dark gray blob with a small orange pixel clipped at the top edge of the front t3 cell, as if a small effect sits just above the frame. Nothing in threequarter or top views; t8/t20 all baseline.
minecraft_angry_villager.notes: Only a few pixels visible at the top edge of one cell; the effect likely sits above the camera frame. Semantics are a guess from color alone.

minecraft_cloud.description: Large billowy white/cream cloud puffs fill the upper-left of front and threequarter t3 cells and appear as a broad white splotch on the grass in top t3. By t8 they shrink to a few scattered small wisps; by t20 every view is back to baseline.
minecraft_cloud.notes: Clean single-burst smoke cloud; fades fast.

minecraft_dripping_honey.description: A thin vertical strand of three to four small amber/gold square droplets descends from the top edge of frame, visible identically at t3, t8 and t20 in both front and threequarter views (a couple of drops also appear in front view lower down). Nothing visible in top view besides background debris.
minecraft_dripping_honey.notes: Consistent sparse drip; source is above the frame so only the falling strand is caught.

minecraft_elder_guardian.description: A huge beige/tan ghostly apparition with radiating spikes and an orange eye/face region fills the left half of front and threequarter t3 cells and the left of top t3 (seen from above). It is completely gone by t8 in every angle.

motion: appears as one big flash then vanishes

minecraft_elder_guardian.notes: Clearly a rendered mob-like sprite flashed for one tick, not a particle burst.

minecraft_falling_dust.description: Clusters of irregular gray blocky flakes hover and drift in the upper sky at front/threequarter t3, thinning to scattered small specks by t8 and nearly gone by t20. In top view they read as flat gray squares resting on or just above the grass at t3/t8.
minecraft_falling_dust.notes: Reads as dry granular debris rather than smoke; colors stay neutral gray.

minecraft_flash.description: Every cell equals the baseline: flat grass, sky horizon, and the persistent brown debris pile in top views. No particles or overlays at any tick or angle.
possible_roles: screen-space flash not capturable in world shots
minecraft_flash.notes: If this effect is a full-screen camera flash it would not appear in third-person world captures; nothing visible at any tick.

minecraft_item.description: At t3 only: a small red square sprite with a white top stripe sits on the grass in front view, with a smaller red speck beside it; threequarter t3 shows the same small red sprite near the debris and top t3 shows a red speck embedded by the debris pile. All empty afterwards.

motion: pops in at t3 then gone

minecraft_item.notes: Looks like a single rendered item sprite (red with light stripe) rather than a particle system; brief appearance.

minecraft_nautilus.description: Dark teal/navy bubble-like dots rise through the sky at t3 in front/threequarter views and trail diagonally upward at t8 before vanishing at t20. The top view is the striking one: at t8 it shows several large blocky spiral shell shapes in blue/cyan with dark navy shading and dark brown centers.

density: several distinct coils plus dot trail
scale_impression: large shells, biggest at top edge

minecraft_nautilus.notes: The spiral motif only resolves clearly in the top view at t8; in side views it reads as dark rising bubbles.

minecraft_sculk_charge_pop.description: Only a few tiny cyan/teal flecks near the top of the front t3 cell and two or three similar marks in threequarter t3. Everything at t8 and t20 and all top views is baseline.
minecraft_sculk_charge_pop.notes: Most of the burst likely sits above the frame; only the fringe is captured.

minecraft_soul_fire_flame.description: A bright cyan flame-shaped sprite cluster floats in the upper-left sky at front t3 and shrinks to a smaller cyan flame at t8; threequarter t3 shows the same cyan flame clipped at the top edge. Gone by t20. Nothing in top views beyond background debris.
minecraft_soul_fire_flame.notes: Reads unmistakably as a cyan flame sprite; brief lifetime.

minecraft_underwater.description: A handful of tiny pale blue-gray specks drift high in the sky at front t3, thinning to one or two specks at t8 and t20; threequarter shows the same sparse dots. Top views show only background debris.
minecraft_underwater.notes: Barely a handful of pixels; could pass for noise but consistent positions across ticks make it a real sparse effect.

world_event_ANIMATION_END_GATEWAY_SPAWN.description: A massive white/light-gray billowing mass explodes into frame at t3: it fills the left third of the front view and sweeps across the left half of the threequarter view with layered cloudy edges and gray shading. By t8 it is completely gone. Top views show only the background debris pile.
world_event_ANIMATION_END_GATEWAY_SPAWN.notes: Reads as a one-frame huge white burst; likely a gateway/teleport flash effect.

world_event_PARTICLES_DESTROY_BLOCK.description: At t3 many dark gray/olive blocky chunks are scattered through the upper frame with smaller purple-gray shards lower near the grass in front and threequarter views; top t3 shows flat dark squares on the grass. By t8 only a few small purple-gray specks remain near ground level; t20 is baseline.

motion: burst outward then fall and settle

world_event_PARTICLES_DESTROY_BLOCK.notes: Classic break-block debris: chunky dark pieces plus finer shards; the purple-gray tint may hint at the destroyed block's material.

world_event_PARTICLES_SCULK_SHRIEK.description: A single tiny cyan wavy squiggle mark sits near the top of the front view at t3 and a similar faint mark at t8; nothing else at any angle or tick. All threequarter and top cells are baseline.
world_event_PARTICLES_SCULK_SHRIEK.notes: Only the fringe of what is probably a large expanding ring is caught at the top edge of the front camera; nearly invisible.

world_event_PARTICLES_TRIAL_SPAWNER_SPAW.description: A burst of orange/yellow flame sprites mixed with dark gray smoke puffs appears in the upper-left sky at front t3 and threequarter t3, with a residual flame or two lingering at t8 at the top edge. All gone by t20; top views show only background debris.

brightness: bright hot orange against dim smoke

world_event_PARTICLES_TRIAL_SPAWNER_SPAW.notes: Fire-plus-smoke burst strongly suggests a spawn/summon ignition.

superheroes_dark_star.description: Small dark multi-point star/sparkle clusters drift slowly across the sky in front and threequarter views at t3, t8 and t20 (moving left to right and thinning). The top view at t20 shows two large dark translucent blocky patches on the grass — a big smoky rectangular shadow mass — absent at earlier ticks.

density: sparse sparkles plus heavy shadow patch

superheroes_dark_star.notes: Two readable components: drifting dark star sparkles in side views and a large dark translucent patch only in top t20.

superheroes_homelander_iron_fists_hand.description: Every cell equals the baseline: grass horizon, empty sky, and only the persistent brown debris pile/scatter in top views. No visible effect at any tick or angle.
superheroes_homelander_iron_fists_hand.notes: Name implies an effect anchored to a hand/fist that may sit outside the captured area or below the frame; nothing visible.

superheroes_kratos_hand_burst_3.description: Tiny clusters of pale cream/white sparkle specks float in the sky at t3, t8 and t20 in both front and threequarter views, drifting slowly rightward with slightly changing positions. Top views show only background debris scatter.
superheroes_kratos_hand_burst_3.notes: Very sparse faint specks; consistent across ticks so a real subtle effect, not noise.

superheroes_scorpion_hellbreath.description: Front and threequarter cells are clean sky and grass at all ticks. Top views show only the persistent brown debris pieces. No visible effect.
superheroes_scorpion_hellbreath.notes: A breath effect likely projects forward from an entity outside this fixed capture volume; nothing in frame at any tick.

superheroes_unibeam_spark.description: A bright cyan chunky spark cluster drifts across the sky in front view at t3, t8 and t20 (shifting rightward, shrinking to a small cyan square by t20), mirrored in threequarter views where t20 shows cyan pieces at the top edge. The top view at t20 shows a large translucent cyan glowing patch covering part of the grass.

motion: lingers and grows into wide glow
density: compact cluster plus wide translucent patch
scale_impression: small cluster expanding to large area

superheroes_unibeam_spark.notes: Reads as a persistent cyan energy spark that ends as a broad translucent glow on the ground in top view.
